verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer ships client-facing software, including the Contract Generator, GDHQ, the D&O Questionnaire Portal and Catalyze, so a public API is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence documents any public API, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404. The documented tools are web-based, self-service or internal (ChatGD), with no programmatic access described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
